MEASUREMENT COMPLETED AND SLICED -- see coordination post. All 13 validators resolved. Correction to my own earlier framing: this is TWO sub-shapes, not one.

(a) SELF-RETURNING VALIDATOR on a public case class, 9 types: TranscriptAtlas, SurfaceAtlas, LatePoolingRecipe, SidecarManifest, FeatureRef, FeatureDerivation, InterviewSource, RecallGraph, PromptPackageManifest. Fix requires BUILDING a witness or smart constructor -- privatising alone is not enough, there is nothing to route through.

(b) REAL SMART CONSTRUCTOR but public case class anyway, 1 type: Gold (embed-bench/gold.scala:73). validated(units, view) already builds and checks it; the type is just publicly constructible. Fix is a private constructor plus a probe. CHEAPEST WIN, do it first, and it establishes the probe pattern the (a) work reuses.

Control: ClaimMeta, same signature as (a), not a defect since slice 2 privatised it.
Out of scope: acquire/patch.scala:192 (documented permissive default) and core/ids.scala:9 (validates a primitive, no type boundary).

Slices A-E proposed per module, independently gateable. Unclaimed.
